title: JAATE HO SUWE MAQTAL ABBAS KHUDA HAFIZ
body:
Bole ye Shahe waala Abbas Khuda hafiz
Ab hogaya ghurbat ka ehsaas Khuda hafiz
Ham hogaye jeene se be aas Khuda hafiz
Faryaad kuna sab ki hai pyaas Khuda hafiz
<<MINI>>
Jaate ho suwe maqtal Abbas Khuda hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
Har simt se aati hai rone ki sada Bhai
Sab Ahle Haram dar par karte hain buka Bhai
Parde ka na chaadar ka kuch hosh raha Bhai
Aate hain unhein kya kya waswaas Khudahafiz
<<MINI>>
Jaate ho suwe maaqtal Abbas Khuda hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
Mazloom hain ham kitne kya waqte musibat hai
Dikhlaaein kise Bhai jo qalb ki haalat hai
Har saans ek aafat hai har lamha qayamat hai
Khaamosh hain lab dil me hai yaas Khudahafiz
<<MINI>>
Jaate ho suwe maqtal Abbas Khuda hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
Phirne lage aankhon me ab dard ke sab manzar
Wo lut'te huwe khaime Wo jalta huwa bistar
Wo neel tamaanchon ke Wo chhinte huwe gohar
Hai kaon Ghareebon ke ab paas Khuda hafiz
<<MINI>>
Jaate ho suwe maqtal Abbas Khuda hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
Hone se Tere rukhsat dil toot gaye Bhayya
Ab to koi pyaasa bhi paani nahi'n maangega
Mazloom musibat me ab kis ko sada Dega
Khaamosh rahegi ab har pyaas Khuda hafiz
<<MINI>>
Jaate ho suwe maqtal Abbas Khuda hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab Shere Jari Tum se lashkar ki bhi zeenat thi
Har ranj me aafat meGham sehne ki taaqat thi
Tum saath rahe jab tak Shabbir ko himmat thi
Ab jeene ka armaa'n hai naa aas Khuda hafiz
<<MINI>>
Jaate ho suwe maqtal Abbas Khuda hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya sakht musibat hai Abbas Tera jaana
Gham hogaya phir taaza Baba ki musibat ka
Ab wagt aseeri ka Zainab ko yaqee'n aaya
Sach hote hain bewon ke waswaas Khuda hafiz
<<MINI>>
Jaate ho suwe maqtal Abbas Khuda hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
Taari tha Sakina pa ghurbat ka ajab aalam
Maidaan ko jaata tha Shabbir ka jab zaiGham
Aati rahi khaimon se bas ek sada paiham
Abbas Khuda hafiz Abbas Khuda hafiz
<<MINI>>
Jaate ho suwe maqtal Abbas Khuda hafiz
author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood
